theme_strategy.rationale: BYD is an innovative, high-tech EV brand. The showroom should feel like stepping into a premium, futuristic luxury dealership—relying heavily on Black, Graphite, Metallic Gray, and White. The dashboard needs hyper-clarity with functional contrast.

headings.font_family: Cabinet Grotesk, General Sans, or Space Grotesk (if allowed on marketing, forbidden on dashboard so use Cabinet Grotesk for both)
headings.strategy: The 'Anti-Default' rule. Headings must be tracked tight (tracking-tighter) for a sleek, performance-oriented automotive feel. Use strong weights for primary statements, thin weights for luxury subtext.

scales.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-bold tracking-tighter leading-none
scales.overline: uppercase text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold tracking-[0.2em] text-gray-400

body.strategy: High legibility, clean geometry. Leading-relaxed for content, leading-normal for UI elements.

rules: NO excessive generic gradients. Flat, rich, structural grayscale only.
Never use pure black #000000; use #050505 tinted slightly with blue or warm tone.
Red accent should be used strictly for primary conversion actions (Booking, Test Drive, Submit).

surfaces.glassmorphism: Restricted to sticky navigations (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-b border-white/10). No muddy transparency. MUST have 1px inner stroke.
surfaces.cards: Solid Graphite (#1C1C1C) or flat transparent borders (border border-white/10) with crisp edges. Nested radii: rounded-2xl parent, rounded-xl child.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlays on hero sections to kill digital flatness and evoke matte automotive paint.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react (Duotone or Light weights). NEVER use cartoonish icons or emojis.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_system: Generous spacing. p-8, p-12, p-16 for containers. The car is the hero; give it room to breathe.
grids_and_layouts.marketing_bento: Asymmetrical Mode A 'Tetris' grid. Mix wide scenic car shots (col-span-8) with tall feature lists (col-span-4). Wide gap-8.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: Mode B High Density grid for CMS. Strict hierarchy. gap-6. Flat rectangular cards without heavy shadows.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Optical alignment over geometric. Left-align text blocks for tech specs to feel engineered and precise.

motion_and_interactions.strategy: Cinematic and subtle. Mimic the smooth acceleration of an EV.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Crisp transformations. Images scale up slightly (scale-105) within hidden overflow. Buttons lift (-translate-y-1) and gain subtle drop-shadow.
motion_and_interactions.scroll: Use Framer Motion for scroll-triggered reveal of featured vehicles. Staggered fade-ins (y: 20 -> y: 0) for lists.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific transition properties. Avoid 'transition-all'. e.g., transition-transform duration-300 ease-out.

components_strategy.marketing: Custom HTML/Tailwind HTML structural layouts to break standard rigid boxes. Custom hero typography. Image overlay MUST be bg-black/40 max.
components_strategy.admin_dashboard: Use Shadcn components extensively (Tables, Cards, Dialogs, Select, Forms). Keep them flat, removing thick default shadows.
components_strategy.ctas: Primary CTA: Solid Red (#D92D20). Secondary CTA: Transparent with White border (border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/10). Floating WhatsApp CTA should be highly visible but elegant.
components_strategy.forms: Minimalist inputs. border-b-2 border-white/20 bg-transparent rounded-none focus:border-red-600. No chunky default inputs.

accessibility.contrast: Text over hero images must use text-shadow or a gradient scrim (bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 via-black/30 to-transparent).
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have clear focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-600).
accessibility.testing: All interactive/key elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

hero_car.description: White luxury electric car, suitable for BYD Seal representation in the hero.

tech_charging.description: Electric car charging, for EV tech highlights.

showroom_exterior.description: Dealership exterior at night with red lighting, representing BYD BIPO Serpong.

dashboard_interior.description: Futuristic car instrument panel, representing BYD intelligent interior.

consultant_reinaldy.description: Professional Asian businessman representing Reinaldy Effendi.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install specific dependencies: framer-motion, lucide-react, sonner.
Implement a premium dark mode for the marketing site and a toggle for the CMS dashboard.
No generic template layouts. Construct the marketing site with dramatic wide images and overlapping text to mimic luxury editorials.
Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for any drop-downs or sticky headers.
Do NOT invent colors outside of Black, White, Graphite, Metallic Gray, and subtle Red.
Ensure 'Reinaldy Effendi' and 'BYD BIPO' are prominently and elegantly displayed.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not converge to generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Push for dramatic contrast and spatial breathing room.
Never apply 'transition: all'. Apply targeted transitions.
Do not center-align body text; align left for engineered readability.
Every interaction needs a micro-animation (hover, click, focus).
Missing images must not fall back to placeholders like dummyimage.com; strictly use the provided image_urls.
